newsitem.title: UK: BA says still plans to sell USAir stake.
newsitem.headline: BA says still plans to sell USAir stake.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Tuesday it still planned to sell on its stake in USAir Group after the U.S. carrier said it would not exercise an option to buy back the shareholding.
BA said last December it planned to sell the 24.6 percent shareholding and its three directors on the USAir board resigned in January. BA is planning a tie-up with USAir's rival American Airlines.
'Our intention is still to sell the stake,' a BA spokesman said. He declined to comment how, when or to whom BA would sell the shareholding.
'We are leaving our options open at this stage,' the spokesman said.
